# Summarizing

## Goal

Prepare an accurate execution checklist or handoff from the current task and plan.

## Procedure

1. Read the task, plan, execution log, and working-tree state.
2. Preserve the original objective, accepted corrections, constraints, completed work, and remaining work.
3. Turn planned steps into concise checkboxes in [Copilot_Execution.md](../TaskLogs/Copilot_Execution.md).
4. Link the source contracts and verification commands instead of copying large files into the log.
5. State the exact next step and any blocker supported by evidence.

## Output

A self-contained execution record that another session can continue. Summarization does not mark work finished or discard earlier requirements.
